00070 void SOSUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00071 {
00072  int filterLoops = UGen::getFilterLoops();
00073  int filterRemain = UGen::getFilterRemain();
00074  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00075  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00076  float* a0Samples = inputs[A0].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00077  float* a1Samples = inputs[A1].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00078  float* a2Samples = inputs[A2].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00079  float* b1Samples = inputs[B1].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00080  float* b2Samples = inputs[B2].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00081  float y0;
00082  
00083  while(filterLoops--)
00084  {
00085   y0 = *inputSamples++ + *b1Samples++ * y1 + *b2Samples++ * y2; 
00086   *outputSamples++ = *a0Samples++ * y0 + *a1Samples++ * y1 + *a2Samples++ * y2;
00087   
00088   y2 = *inputSamples++ + *b1Samples++ * y0 + *b2Samples++ * y1; 
00089   *outputSamples++ = *a0Samples++ * y2 + *a1Samples++ * y0 + *a2Samples++ * y1;
00090   
00091   y1 = *inputSamples++ + *b1Samples++ * y2 + *b2Samples++ * y0; 
00092   *outputSamples++ = *a0Samples++ * y1 + *a1Samples++ * y2 + *a2Samples++ * y0;
00093  }
00094  
00095  while(filterRemain--)
00096  {
00097   y0 = *inputSamples++ + *b1Samples++ * y1 + *b2Samples++ * y2; 
00098   *outputSamples++ = *a0Samples++ * y0 + *a1Samples++ * y1 + *a2Samples++ * y2;
00099 
00100   y2 = y1; 
00101   y1 = y0;
00102  }
00103  
00104  y1 = zap(y1);
00105  y2 = zap(y2);
00106 }

00108 void SOSUGenInternal::initValue(const float value) throw()
00109 {
00110  float checkedValue = zap(value);
00111  UGenInternal::initValue(checkedValue);
00112  y1 = y2 = checkedValue;
00113 }
